build_transform: build an image transform pipeline that converts to RGB, resizes, tensors, and normalizes with given mean and std
find_closest_aspect_ratio: find the closest matching aspect ratio from a set of target ratios for a given image dimensions
dynamic_preprocess: dynamically preprocess an image by splitting into tiles based on aspect ratio with optional thumbnail
image_to_pixel_values: convert an image to normalized pixel value tensor using dynamic tiling and image preprocessing
test_dynamic_preprocess: test dynamic image preprocessing with various aspect ratios and tile configurations
